objective: Developers creating a spec in the frontend get stuck in Draft forever because the UI never shows the clarification questions that the backend generates. Without those questions, the user doesn't know what's missing and the spec can never reach 'approved'.
outcomes: After 'Create Spec' succeeds, the modal transitions to a step-2 that fetches and displays all questions from GET /specs/:id/questions
Each question renders with a labelled textarea for the user's answer
Clicking 'Submit Answers' sends a PATCH /specs/:id request with the mapped answers and shows a loading state
On success the modal closes and the browser navigates to /specs/:id
If /questions returns an empty array the modal closes immediately (no questions step)
The spec detail page at /specs/:id shows a 'Pending Questions' banner when questions remain unanswered (status === draft and questions exist)

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Skip the questions step entirely and close the modal immediately
Show an error message in the modal with a retry option; do not close

edgeCases.scenario: User submits answers with all fields blank
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Disable the Submit button unless at least one answer has text
Show error inline in the modal, keep it open so the user can retry

edgeCases.scenario: User closes the modal during the questions step
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Modal closes; spec remains in draft; user can re-open questions from the spec detail page

constraints: No new npm dependencies — use only what is already in the frontend package.json
The PATCH /specs/:id backend endpoint must reuse the existing updateSpec() core function
Do not change the NewSpecModal's step-1 (request textarea) behaviour
healthMetrics: Existing spec creation (step 1) still works end-to-end
Existing backend server tests still pass
verification: Create a spec in the frontend — modal shows step 2 with questions fetched from backend
Type answers and click Submit Answers — browser navigates to /specs/:id
Visit the spec detail page for a draft spec with open questions — pending questions banner is visible
Leave all answer fields blank — Submit Answers button is disabled
Close modal during step 2 — modal closes, spec stays in draft
